requirement.description: ModuleNotFoundError for example modules in test environment. Tests reference modules like 'examples.workflows.hera_runner.typed_script_input_output' that are not available in the test environment.
requirement.contract: Fix import resolution to properly handle example modules in test environment. Ensure that example modules are either bundled with the package or properly mocked during testing.

requirement.description: ValueError: source code string cannot contain null bytes in CLI tests. Tests fail when trying to process source code that contains null bytes.
requirement.contract: Implement proper handling of source code files that may contain null bytes. Ensure that the CLI functionality can process files safely without crashing on null byte detection.

requirement.description: NameError: name 'param_name' is not defined in artifact loading functionality. This indicates missing variable declaration in artifact loading code.
requirement.contract: Fix the NameError by ensuring all variables used in artifact loading are properly declared. Specifically, resolve the 'param_name' variable issue in artifact loading functions.

requirement.description: IsADirectoryError when creating output directories. Tests fail when trying to create output directories due to directory path conflicts or permissions issues.
requirement.contract: Fix directory creation logic to properly handle cases where output directories already exist or are being accessed incorrectly. Ensure that temporary output directories are properly managed.

requirement.description: TypeError: Object of type NonUserNonBaseModelClass is not JSON serializable in artifact dumping functionality. This indicates issues with serializing custom Pydantic models.
requirement.contract: Ensure that custom Pydantic models are properly serializable. Fix the artifact dumping functionality to handle non-base model classes correctly by implementing proper serialization mechanisms.
